sections.label: What made it hard
sections.html:
• Two sources of truthOne of the first external APIs on Actifai’s order framework where state lives on both sides: an order lives in Actifai and in the provider’s billing system, and the two have to agree. The provider calls back with each order’s status, which is how we catch a mismatch.
  • Plan mappingSingle, double, and triple play orders (internet, TV, and phone, alone or bundled) have to map onto each provider’s billing products.
  • Go-live coordinationEach launch lines up the provider and its integration partners, and I gather the requirements with them. A runbook covers each new provider’s credentials and config, plan mapping, and go-live checklist.

sections.label: When an order fails
sections.html:
A failed submission goes into an exceptions queue in Actifai’s manager portal, where staff fix and resend it, and the provider gets an email when one of its orders is flagged.

A correlation ID on every submission ties logs, Datadog monitors, and the queue to one order, with personal data redacted first.
